achievement.1.description: Una macho kwa maeneo ya kutiliwa shaka na unapenda kusoma shajara za watu wengine, haswa zile zilizo na hadithi za vampire ndani yake. Wewe pia ni mkusanyaji na mgunduzi aliyejitolea. Heshima!
achievement.1.name: [EN] Castlemania
achievement.10.description: Unafuata njia ya ndoto na ile ya uwajibikaji bila nguvu ya ubinafsi. Bila uchoyo na ubinafsi, unasaidia wengine bila kutarajia malipo.
achievement.10.name: Knight ndoto
achievement.100.description: Vitu vichache ni sawa na hasira kali ya kiumbe aliyenaswa na aliyevurugwa. Ulikuwa mpinzani anayestahili.
achievement.100.name: Muuaji wa Irahsae
achievement.101.description: Chuki kipofu ilichukua sura ya kimwili, ikiasi kwa jeuri dhidi ya udhalimu uliozaliwa ndani yake. Hukuweza kuleta haki - lakini angalau amani ya muda.
achievement.101.name: Muuaji wa Phrodomo
achievement.102.description: Ujuzi uliokatazwa wa eons haukukusudiwa kamwe kuivamia ulimwengu huu. Ulinyamazisha sauti yake kabla ya kusikika.
achievement.102.name: Muuaji wa Teneshpar
achievement.103.description: Ulisaidia kuleta hema hatari za Devovorga na kifuko chake cha ucheshi chini - bila kusimamisha mabadiliko yake, lakini hatimaye kukamilisha hatua muhimu ya kifo chake.
achievement.103.name: [EN] Cocoon of Doom
achievement.104.description: Shujaa mmoja maalum kati ya wengi. Mwaka huu - ilikuwa wewe. Devovorga alijiondoa katika ulimwengu wa giza kwa sababu hakuweza kuhimili nguvu zako - na za wenzi wako. Muda utaonyesha ikiwa chaguo ulilofanya lilikuwa zuri - lakini kwa sasa, liliokoa ulimwengu wako.
achievement.104.name: [EN] Devovorga's Nemesis
achievement.105.description: Umechoka... nimechoka sana... kujikunja kwenye kitanda chenye joto na laini inaonekana kuwa jambo bora kufanya hivi sasa. Ndoto tamu!
achievement.105.name: Bwana Sandman
achievement.106.description: Kulala - unafanya kwa mtindo. Unatulia kwenye chandarua chako, ukisikiliza sauti ya ndege na kriketi huku ukipeperushwa polepole hadi kwenye ulimwengu wa ndoto.
achievement.106.name: Nitishe Nilale
achievement.107.description: Huhitaji sana kulala kwa raha. Rundo la majani na paa juu ya kichwa chako - na la pili likiwa ni chaguo kabisa - inatosha kabisa kupumzika. Hujali hata panya kunyonya vidole vyako.
achievement.107.name: Mgeni Mwema
achievement.108.description: Kweli - yaliyomo kwenye zawadi hiyo hayakuwa vile ulivyotarajia. Na marafiki kama hawa, ni nani anayehitaji maadui?
achievement.108.name: Utani unakuhusu
achievement.109.description: Sana kwa rafiki yako mdogo mwenye manyoya! Labda amesimama mbele ya ngome ya ndege, akiminya shingo yake na kupiga kelele 'Imba! Imba! Imba!' ilikuwa kidogo sana kwa hilo?!
achievement.109.name: Lo!
achievement.11.description: Umejiunga na ndugu wasiokufa - kufanya kifo kuwa adui yako na silaha yako pia. Kula kilicho dhaifu na kuacha nafasi kwa kilicho na nguvu ndilo lengo lako kuu.
achievement.11.name: Ndugu Mfupa
achievement.110.description: Unaishi maisha ya wawindaji na wakusanyaji. Kweli, haswa ile ya mkusanyaji, na haswa yule anayekusanya matunda mengi ya blueberries. Je, umeangalia rangi ya ulimi wako hivi majuzi?
achievement.110.name: Bluebarian
achievement.111.description: Nene, nyekundu - iliyotikiswa, isiyochochewa - na yenye majani ndani yake: ndivyo unavyopendelea damu yako ya pepo. Inatumiwa na pete ya vitunguu, ladha ya hila ya metali ni karibu haionekani. Athari za manufaa kwa afya au mana zinakaribishwa.
achievement.111.name: Mlinda baa mwenye Pepo
achievement.112.description: Unapenda majira ya baridi. Ukiwa na skafu na glavu kikamilifu, unapenda kufurahiya nje huku ukijenga watu wengi wanaotembea kwa theluji na marafiki zako. Mapigano ya mpira wa theluji, mtu yeyote?
achievement.112.name: Mtu wa theluji
achievement.113.name: Idadi ya Mnyama
achievement.114.description: Wewe na marafiki zako wenye manyoya waliojaa vitu hamwezi kutenganishwa, na huoni aibu kuwapeleka kitandani pamoja nawe - ni nani anayejua ni lini utaamka katikati ya usiku ukiwa na haja kubwa ya kubembelezwa?
achievement.114.name: Nahitaji Kukumbatiwa
achievement.115.description: Sawa, tukubaliane nayo - mradi unaamini kwamba inaweza kukuongoza kwenye hazina kubwa zaidi kuwahi kutokea, hutaiacha ramani hiyo, hata kama inaweza kuonekana kuwa ya kuvutia. Lazima kuna siri nyuma ya haya yote!
achievement.115.name: Nafasi Nyembamba
achievement.116.description: Labda wewe si mwanafunzi wa haraka au unapata raha ya kujichoma moto. Au unatafuta tu jina la kifahari. Kwa hali yoyote, unapaswa kujua kwamba kupitisha gesi wakati wa majaribio yako ya punda ndogo haipendekezi.
achievement.116.name: Roketi katika Pocket
achievement.117.description: Lakini funga macho yako na usimwambie mtu yeyote kile ulichotaka, au haitatimia!
achievement.117.name: Fanya Tamaa
achievement.118.description: Krismasi ni wakati unaopenda zaidi wa mwaka, na kijana, unapenda zawadi. Wanunulie marafiki zako vitu vizuri, vifiche hadi - vema, hadi uamue kuvifunua badala yake wewe mwenyewe.
achievement.118.name: Msaidizi wa Li'l wa Santa
achievement.119.description: Hasira ya Spawn ya Noxious - uliweza kuipata kwa bahati mbaya. Siku zako zimehesabiwa na kifo chako hakiepukiki. Wakati fulani. Mahali fulani.
achievement.119.name: Cursed!
achievement.12.description: Ulisafiri ulimwenguni kwa maombi karibu yasiyo na maana - lakini angalau sio lazima ufanye hivyo tena na unaweza kupata hisa mpya iliyobarikiwa kwa kupepesa kwa jicho.
achievement.12.name: Ubarikiwe!
achievement.120.description: Ndio! Watafutaji washikaji, waliopotea walia! Ni nani anayejali vitu hivyo vyote vilitoka wapi na ikiwa ilibidi utambae kupitia marundo ya taka ili kuvipata? Ni BURE!
achievement.120.name: Vipengee vya Bure!
achievement.121.description: Juu na chini na juu na chini ... na kisha kitanzi kikubwa! Subiri - hawajengi vitanzi huko Kazordoon. Lakini upandaji wa gari la ore bado unafurahisha!
achievement.121.name: [EN] Rollercoaster
achievement.122.description: Wewe, Bwana au Bibi, ni alchemist wa kweli. Kufanya majaribio ya kubadilisha ili kupata kila mchanganyiko unaowezekana imekuwa shauku yako ya siri tangu miaka mingi na matokeo ya utafiti wako ni ya ajabu. Sayansi imechukua hatua kubwa hivi punde!
achievement.122.name: [EN] Transmutator
achievement.123.description: RAWR! Nguvu inapita kwenye mwili wako, moyo wako unaenda mbio haraka na adrenaline ikichochea kila aina ya silaha yako. Yote kwenye chupa kidogo. Hakuna kurejeshewa kwa samani zilizoharibiwa. Kwa maswali zaidi wasiliana na mganga wako au muuza madawa ya kulevya.
achievement.123.name: Berserker
achievement.124.description: Unahisi unaweza kutatua mafumbo magumu zaidi ndani ya dakika moja au zaidi. Zaidi ya hayo, kuna uboreshaji mzuri kwenye uharibifu wako wa tahajia. Yote kwenye chupa kidogo. Madhara - kujisikia mjinga kidogo. Kwa maswali zaidi wasiliana na mganga wako au muuza madawa ya kulevya.
achievement.124.name: Mwenye akili
achievement.125.description: Kuboresha macho, mishale na bolts kuruka kwa kasi ya mwanga na kuwabana adui zako na uharibifu wa ziada. Yote kwenye chupa kidogo. Hakuna matumizi ya karoti inahitajika. Kwa maswali zaidi wasiliana na mganga wako au muuza madawa ya kulevya.
achievement.125.name: [EN] Sharpshooter
achievement.126.description: Urgh! Funga madirisha! Zima jua ukikuza kichwa chake kibaya cha manjano, funga kicheko cha kupasua masikio cha watoto wa jirani yako. Ahhh. Kukumbatia giza tamu na ukimya.
achievement.126.name: Usinisumbue
achievement.127.description: Inuka na uangaze! Ni siku mpya nzuri - fungua madirisha yako, uhisi mwanga wa jua wenye joto, tazama ndege wakiimba kwenye dirisha lako na utunzaji wa mimea yako. Kuna sababu gani ya kutokuwa na furaha?
achievement.127.name: Wacha Jua Liingie
achievement.128.description: Argh! Si sasa! Inakuwaje kwamba zana hizo zenye kazi nyingi hazishindwi wakati unazitumia kwa jambo dogo kama kukamua juisi, lakini zinavuruga wakati unahitaji sana kupanda juu ya eneo la kamba na joka linalopumua moto likikufukuza?
achievement.128.name: Muda Mbaya
achievement.129.description: Unawacheka wasafiri ambao hawajajiandaa waliokwama kwenye nyasi ndefu au kuni za kukimbilia. Au labda unawasaidia. Wanakuita... 'Machete'.
achievement.129.name: Hakuna Kinachoweza Kunizuia
achievement.13.description: Wewe ni mfanyabiashara hodari ambaye unaweza kushughulikia bidhaa kwa uangalifu, hupata ofa nzuri na huchimbua nadra kila mara. Kamwe usichelewe kukamilisha agizo, wewe ni mfanyabiashara anayeaminika - angalau machoni pa Rashid.
achievement.13.name: Mfanyabiashara Anayetambulika
achievement.130.description: Scythe iliruka juu ya bega lako, jua likiwaka mgongoni mwako - wewe ni mkulima moyoni na unapenda kufanya kazi shambani. Au basi tena labda unaunda duru za kupendeza za mazao ili kuwatisha wanaume wenzako.
achievement.130.name: Furaha Mkulima
achievement.131.description: Liberty Bay ndiyo hangout inayofaa kwako na kuvuna miwa ni shughuli ya kustarehesha kabisa. Je, ungependa chai na sukari yako, mheshimiwa?
achievement.131.name: Utamu wa Asili
achievement.132.description: Yo-ho-ho na chupa ya ramu - iliyotengenezwa nyumbani, bila shaka, iliyofanywa kutoka kwa mimea ya miwa iliyochaguliwa kwa mikono na ya kibinafsi. Sasa, acha izeeke kwenye pipa la mwaloni na ufurahie baada ya miaka 10. Au kwa wale wasio na subira: Wacha tufanye sherehe sasa hivi!
achievement.132.name: Homebrewed
achievement.133.description: Hazina zilizofichwa chini ya matuta ya mchanga wa jangwa - una pua ya kuzipata na unajua wapi kuchimba. Huenda zisikufanye kuwa tajiri mchafu, lakini zinang'aa na nzuri hata hivyo.
achievement.133.name: [EN] Gold Digger
achievement.134.description: Wewe na koleo lako - mechi iliyofanywa mbinguni. Au kuzimu, kwa jambo hilo. Mahali pengine chini kwa hali yoyote. Unavutiwa kichawi na milundo ya mawe na unapenda kuzifungua na kuona ni wapi mashimo hayo yanakupeleka. Biceps nzuri pia.
achievement.134.name: Mzishi
achievement.135.description: Unaweza kupatikana kwa urahisi na mtu yeyote ikiwa atafuata tu njia ya makombo ya kuki. Na kwako, upendo wa kweli unamaanisha kutoa kuki yako ya mwisho.
achievement.135.name: Kuki Monster
achievement.136.description: Na yeyote anayedai vinginevyo ni mwongo.
achievement.136.name: Keki ni Ukweli
achievement.137.description: Huenda kitabu maarufu cha 'Ode to a Molten Chocolate Cake' kiliandikwa na wewe. Kutumia alasiri ya mvua mbele ya bomba la moshi, ukiwa umefunikwa kwa blanketi huku ukijifurahisha kwa kakao kunasikika kama kitu ambacho ungefanya. Furahia!
achievement.137.name: Jino Tamu
achievement.138.description: Unapenda keki yako laini, na vipande vya matunda na icing nzuri ya sukari. Na unapendelea kuwafanya peke yako. Je, umewahi kufikiria kufungua duka la mikate? Lazima uwe mzuri sana sasa!
achievement.138.name: Na Cherry Juu
achievement.139.description: Muahhaha ni... mutated pumpkin! Baada ya kusaidia kuiondoa - ULISAIDIA, sivyo? - ulidai thawabu yako na ukapata zawadi ya kushangaza zaidi au kidogo. Furaha ya Halloween!
achievement.139.name: [EN] Mutated Presents
achievement.14.description: Ulipata na kunywa kutoka Chemchemi ya Uzima. Ulifikiri haikukupa uzima wa milele, unahisi kubadilika na kwa namna fulani kuwa na amani.
achievement.14.name: Chemchemi ya Uzima
achievement.140.description: Mmoja wa Lightbearers. Mmoja wa wale waliosaidia kuweka mabeseni kuwaka na kufanya kazi pamoja dhidi ya giza. Minong'ono ya pepo nyuma ya pazia nyembamba kati ya walimwengu - walinyamazishwa tena kwa msaada wako.
achievement.140.name: Mlinzi wa Moto
achievement.141.description: Wewe ni mmoja wa Lightbearers waliojitolea zaidi - bila wewe, mapepo yangepasua pazia kati ya walimwengu bila shaka. Umewasha kila beseni, ukisafiri juu na chini, ukirudisha nyuma nguvu za ulimwengu mwingine. Hebu iwe na mwanga!
achievement.141.name: Kweli Lightbearer
achievement.142.description: Umeshinda mwili wa Mungu wa Nyoka na, kwa swing ya mwisho yenye nguvu ya fimbo ya enzi ya nyoka, ulikata usambazaji wake wa nguvu ya maisha. Hadithi ya mamlaka, udanganyifu na ufisadi imefikia mwisho - au ... sivyo?
achievement.142.name: Godslayer
achievement.143.description: Uhm... ni mtu gani huyo ambaye umeamka kando yake? Miwani ya cocktail iliyovunjika kwenye sakafu, maua kwenye chumba, na kwa nini umevaa pete? Jana lazima iwe ilikuwa siku ndefu, ya kushangaza ...
achievement.143.name: Siku Baada Ya
achievement.144.description: Mahusiano ya muda mrefu sio kwako tu. Na kila wakati unapofikiri uko katika mapenzi, unathibitishwa kuwa umekosea muda mfupi baadaye. Au labda unaishia tu na mpenzi mbaya kila wakati - kunyonywa na kusalitiwa. Kukaa bila kuolewa kunaweza kuwa bora zaidi.
achievement.144.name: Kujitolea Phobic
achievement.145.description: Je, unaamini? Upendo? Uaminifu? Pah! Hisia za zamani. Kwa muda mrefu kama unafurahiya, haujali kukanyaga mioyo mingi. Ikiwezekana wakati wa kuvaa buti za mapigano.
achievement.145.name: Mvunja moyo
achievement.146.description: Stealth unaua na backstabbing ni wewe maalum. Wahasiriwa wako wengi kwa kawaida hawajui kifo chao kinachokaribia, ambacho unawaletea kimya na haraka. Kila kitu kinaruhusiwa.
achievement.146.name: Kifo cha Mwepesi
achievement.147.description: Ni nini bora maishani? Kuponda adui zako. Kuwaona wakiendeshwa mbele yako. Na labda kuwa na kikombe kizuri cha chai baadaye.
achievement.147.name: Adabu ya Kikatili
achievement.148.description: Wewe ni mwombaji, huna makazi, umevaa nguo chafu na chakavu. Lakini hiyo haimaanishi kwamba unapaswa kuomba mtu yeyote kwa ajili ya mambo - na bado ulihifadhi kiburi chako. Manyoya nzuri si lazima kufanya ndege nzuri - ni nini chini yao ni muhimu zaidi.
achievement.148.name: Maisha ya Mtaani
achievement.149.description: Ukiwa umevaa nembo na mavazi meusi ya Udugu wa Mifupa unazurura katika nchi ukieneza hofu na maumivu, ukitengeneza askari wapya kwa ajili ya jeshi la necromantic ambalo linakaribia kuinuka hivi karibuni. Salamu Udugu.
achievement.149.name: Fuvu na Mifupa
achievement.15.description: Ulisafiri ulimwengu wa nyanja za msingi, ukamwita na kumuua Bwana wa Vipengele, yote ili kupata jambo lisiloegemea upande wowote. Na kama ulivyokuwa jasiri, haungeweza kuifanya bila timu yako!
achievement.15.name: Bwana wa Vipengele
achievement.150.description: Huogopi jinamizi, unasafiri ndani yake - unakabiliwa na vitisho vingi na kupigana na hatima wanayokaribia kuleta. Ni wachache wanaoamini unabii mbaya unaoleta kutoka kwa ndoto hizo, lakini wale wanaopigana pamoja nawe kama Nightmare Knights.
achievement.150.name: Mtembezi wa Ndoto
achievement.151.description: Kila jiji linapaswa kujivunia kumwita mtu kama wewe mkaaji wake. Unaweka barabara safi na kusaidia kusuluhisha mizozo ya kawaida mbele ya bohari. Pia, labda unamiliki paka na unapenda kupanda mlima.
achievement.151.name: Mwananchi wa Mfano
achievement.152.description: Hubebi hisa hiyo kwa ajili ya mapambo tu - uko tayari kuitumia. Kwa kawaida unaonekana ukiruka juu kwenye shimo lenye kina kirefu zaidi ukiacha msururu wa pepo waliouawa. Yeyote atakayethubutu kusimama katika njia yako ajiandae kufa.
achievement.152.name: Demonbane
achievement.153.description: Moja na asili, moja na wanyamapori. Nguvu mbichi na ya mnyama, hisia kali, kulia kwenye miamba ya juu na kunguruma kwenye misitu minene - ni wewe.
achievement.153.name: Ya Mbwa Mwitu na Dubu
achievement.154.description: Wakati wa mchana unaweza kupatikana umejificha msituni ukiweka mitego au ukifuata wanyama wakubwa, usiku umeketi kando ya moto na kushiriki hadithi zako za uwindaji. Unakula ulichowinda na kuvaa ulichochuna. Maisha yanaweza kuendelea hivyo milele.
achievement.154.name: Uwindaji kwa Sinema
achievement.155.description: Na kumbuka: Usijaribu kamwe kufundisha nguruwe kuimba. Inapoteza muda wako na inakera nguruwe.
achievement.155.name: Mpumbavu Moyoni
achievement.156.description: Ukiwa na makali yenye makali na ukiwa na silaha kamili ya sahani, unawashambulia adui zako kwa nguvu na ushujaa. Daima kuna msichana wa kuokoa na joka kuua kwa ajili yako.
achievement.156.name: Katika Silaha za Kuangaza
achievement.157.description: Unaanza siku yako kwa kuoga kwenye sufuria yako ya dhahabu na haujali kuonyesha utajiri wako wakati unatembea barabarani umevaa nguo zako bora - baada ya yote ni pesa zako ulizochuma kwa bidii! Unapendelea kushughulikiwa na 'Mtukufu wako'.
achievement.157.name: Aristocrat
achievement.158.description: Marundo ya theluji na mvua ya mawe haviwezi kukuzuia kutoka unapotaka kwenda. Umejitayarisha kikamilifu kwa safari yoyote katika barafu ya kudumu na unajua jinsi ya kuweka miguu yako joto. Ikiwa wewe ni mwanamke, hiyo ni mafanikio makubwa, pia.
achievement.158.name: Nje katika Dhoruba ya theluji
achievement.159.description: Unajisikia nyumbani chini ya jua kali la jangwa na mchanga kati ya vidole vyako, na njia unayopenda ya kusafiri ni carpet ya kuruka. Pia, pengine unaweza kufanya hoja hiyo ya densi ya kutengwa na kichwa.
achievement.159.name: Elfu Moja na Moja
achievement.16.description: Uliigiza tena Ufugaji wa Shrew kwenye mazingira ya ufuo na kuthibitisha kuwa unaweza kushughulikia wasichana wasio na akili vizuri kabisa. Na au bila mikia ya samaki.
achievement.16.name: Pwani Tamer
achievement.160.description: Nyinyi kuwa muungwana o 'bahati, fightin' na carousin' juu ya bahari kuu, nje fer ngawira na lassies! Nyinyi msiwe na jibu kwa mtu yeyote au ufalme uliolipuliwa na maisha si ya lily-livered. Ndio, jamaa!
achievement.160.name: [EN] Swashbuckler
achievement.161.description: Kutikisa njuga yako na kucheza karibu na moto kwa ngoma za msituni kunasikika kama kitu unachopenda kufanya. Mbali na hilo, dreadlocks ni njia rahisi ya kuvaa nywele zako - hakuna kuchanganya inahitajika!
achievement.161.name: Njia ya Shaman
achievement.162.description: Unaweza kuwa mwandishi wa opus kubwa 'Jinsi ya Kumwita Mnyama wa Mwisho kutoka kwa kina cha Infernal, Juzuu ya I'. Au, ikiwa akili na moyo wako ni safi, afadhali uwaite viumbe kusaidia wengine. Au labda paka mdogo tu kuwa na mtu wa kubembeleza.
achievement.162.name: Ritualist
achievement.163.description: Huogopi kuonyesha rangi zako kwenye joto la vita. Maadui wanaogopa mkuki wako mbaya na silaha zisizoweza kupenyeka. Orodha ya vita ambavyo umeshinda ni ya kuvutia. Salamu na kuua!
achievement.163.name: Mwalimu wa Vita
achievement.164.description: Ushujaa ni kwa wanyonge - haijalishi jinsi unavyoshinda vita, mradi tu wewe ni mshindi. Silaha nene zinaweza kuzuia harakati zako, kwa hivyo unaifanya iwe nyepesi na unategemea kasi na ujuzi badala ya kujificha kwenye ganda lisilofaa.
achievement.164.name: [EN] Wild Warrior
achievement.165.description: Wewe ni shujaa mnyenyekevu ambaye hauhitaji mali au vifaa maalum kwa kusafiri na kupigana. Unajisikia uko nyumbani katika ardhi ya kaskazini ya Zao na ulifanya sehemu yako katika kupambana na ufisadi wake.
achievement.165.name: [EN] Peazzekeeper
achievement.166.description: Matendo yako kwa Yalahar kawaida yana sifa ya utambuzi wa kina na vitendo vya kufikiria. Asante kwako, Yalahar anaweza kuwa na nafasi ya kukua kwa amani na watu wenye furaha wanaoishi humo.
achievement.166.name: Yalahari ya Hekima
achievement.167.description: Unatetea Yalahar kwa nguvu ya kikatili na uko tayari kuiongoza kwenye vita vitukufu, ikiwa ni lazima. Shukrani kwako, Yalahar itakuwa na nguvu ya kutosha kusimama dhidi ya adui yeyote.
achievement.167.name: Yalahari ya Nguvu
achievement.168.description: Maisha yanaweza kuwa rahisi sana na keki inayofaa kwa wakati unaofaa - na umejua kuoka nyingi tofauti, kwa hivyo unapaswa kuwa tayari kwa karibu kila kitu ambacho maisha huamua kukutupa.
achievement.168.name: Kipande cha Keki
achievement.169.description: Unachukuliwa kuwa mhitimu wa daraja la kwanza katika Chuo cha Uchawi huko Edron kutokana na uvumbuzi wako wa awali na masomo yenye mafanikio katika nyanja ya majaribio ya uchawi na ukuzaji tahajia. Umewahi kufikiria kufundisha spell ya Har–Magedoni?
achievement.169.name: Alumni
achievement.17.description: Unapofanya kitu, unafanya sawa. Una maoni na unasimama nayo - na hakuna mtu atakayeweza kukushawishi vinginevyo. Kwa upande mwingine, uko upande wa kikatili na wenye mwelekeo wa vita, lakini hilo si jambo baya, sivyo?
achievement.17.name: Mfuasi wa Azerus
achievement.170.description: Wewe ni mjuzi katika njia nyeusi za uchawi na kwa kawaida hupatikana ukiwa umeketi ndani ya duara la mishumaa na mafuvu yakinung'unika maneno yasiyosemeka. Usibebe vitu mbali sana au pepo wanaweza kuja kukuchukua.
achievement.170.name: Warlock
achievement.171.description: Hakika, una doa laini kwa sungura. Labda sungura uliowahifadhi leo watakuwa sungura ambao watakuokoa kesho. Wakati una njaa kweli.
achievement.171.name: Sungura Ameteleza
achievement.172.description: Wanasayansi wa kweli wanajua vifaa vyao. Kujaribu uvumbuzi mpya ni kazi muhimu ya kila siku kwa mtafiti yeyote anayefanya kazi kwa bidii. Hukuonyesha woga na ulichukua vifaa vyote vipya kutoka kwa Spectulus na Sinclair kwa spin.
achievement.172.name: Nguruwe wa Guinea
achievement.173.description: Uliingia msituni, ukakutana na Rottin Wood na Wanaume Walioolewa na ukawasaidia katika kambi yao. Lo, na usijali kuhusu wafanyabiashara hao. Hawatathubutu kutaja kiasi kikubwa cha ajabu cha dhahabu walichokuwa nacho ambacho hakipo sasa.
achievement.173.name: [EN] Merry Adventures
achievement.174.description: Ulifaulu mtihani wao na kusaidia vifaa vya upimaji vya Spirithunters, kutafiti juu ya miujiza na kupata vizuka - ni wewe watakupigia simu.
achievement.174.name: Haogopi Roho!
achievement.175.description: Takriban mimea yote uliyoifanyia majaribio Chartan huko Zao ambapo haiwezi kuliwa - uliionja yote, lakini bado umesimama! Unapaswa kupata hewa safi sasa, ingawa.
achievement.175.name: [EN] Extreme Degustation
achievement.176.description: Umeingia kwa ujasiri kwenye kisiwa cha keki. Je, kuna mahali pengine pazuri na pazuri pa kuwa ulimwenguni kote?
achievement.176.name: Mshindi wa Keki
achievement.177.description: Umemchangamsha mtoto wa pepo na kumrudishia mama yake. Hesabu ya haraka ya vidole vyako itadhihirisha ikiwa umefanikiwa bila kudhurika.
achievement.177.name: Mtoto Mlezi
achievement.178.description: Umechangamsha kundi la watoto wachanga wa mapepo na kuwarudisha kwa mama yao. Usisumbue alama za kuchoma, usisumbue shida za nywele za kijivu, usisumbue usiku unapoamka kupiga kelele. Ilikuwa na thamani yake ... pengine ... kwa namna fulani.
achievement.178.name: Nanny kutoka Kuzimu
achievement.179.description: Umesafiri bahari ya chini na Ghost Captain. Licha ya hatari, wewe na wafanyakazi wenzako mmeshinda changamoto.
achievement.179.name: [EN] Ghost Sailor
achievement.18.description: Wewe ni mlinzi wa amani na sikiliza watu wadogo wanasema nini. Umeamua na unajua ni nani wa kusaidia na kwa sababu zipi - na unafanya hivyo mara kwa mara. Vita yako inapiganwa kwa sababu badala ya silaha.
achievement.18.name: Mfuasi wa Palimuth
achievement.180.description: Umesafiri bahari ya chini na Ghost Captain mara kadhaa. Hatari za watu wa chini zimejulikana kwako na wasafiri wasio na uzoefu wanakugeukia kwa ushauri.
achievement.180.name: Msafiri wa Spectral
achievement.181.description: Bila kuogopa kifo au mizimu umesafiri na nahodha wa roho mara kadhaa na wewe ni msafiri mwenye uzoefu wa ulimwengu wa wafu. Wafu na walio hai wananong'ona juu ya ushujaa wako kwa shukrani.
achievement.181.name: [EN] Nether Pirate
achievement.182.description: Wewe ni bwana wa bahari ya chini na umesafiri na nahodha wa roho mara nyingi sana kwamba unajua meli yake na hatari za bahari ya chini ndani nje. Unacheka usoni mwa kifo na unaweza kurudi kama maharamia wa roho katika maisha ya baada ya kifo!
achievement.182.name: Janga la Kifo
achievement.183.description: Umesaidia kuwasha moto wachawi. Tazama tu vidole vyako, ni moto!
achievement.183.name: Moto Nyepesi
achievement.184.description: Ulitoa viungo ili kuunda pombe ya kinga ya wachawi.
achievement.184.name: Wachawi Lil' Msaidizi
achievement.185.description: Ulijitolea viungo vingi kuunda pombe ya kinga ya wachawi na ukachukua sehemu kubwa katika juhudi za kuwafukuza waleta machafuko. Kikwazo ni kwamba hata wale wanaoleta mabaya wanaweza kukutambua ...
achievement.185.name: [EN] Banebringers' Bane
achievement.186.description: Ili kuweka moto wa wachawi uwaka, ulitupa kuni nyingi zilizohuishwa. Wengine wanaweza kupata hamu yako ya moto ... inasumbua.
achievement.186.name: Fire Devil
achievement.187.description: [SW] Love ... fire! So ... shiny! Must ... buuuurrrn!
achievement.187.name: Pyromaniac
achievement.188.description: Juhudi zako za kupigana na waleta machafuko hazijaonekana. Wewe ni hadithi miongoni mwa wachawi na jina lako linanong'ona kwa mshangao na pongezi.
achievement.188.name: Mchawi wa heshima
achievement.189.description: Ah, furaha ya kupanda! Unayo mlima wako wa kwanza tu. Kwa urahisi wa kutosha hauitaji hata mazizi, lakini unaweza kuiita wakati wowote upendao.
achievement.189.name: Asili Born Cowboy
achievement.19.description: Unaruka katika kila fursa ya changamoto ya uwindaji ambayo hutolewa kwako na kutekeleza majukumu hayo kwa usahihi mbaya. Wewe ni mwindaji moyoni na mwanachama muhimu wa Paw & Fur Society.
achievement.19.name: Wawindaji wa Wasomi
achievement.190.description: Mawe yamekuvutia kila wakati. Kwa hivyo ana nafasi ya kupata kitu cha thamani sana ndani ya mmoja wao. Kitakwimu unapaswa kuwa umegundua hazina chache nzuri kwa sasa. Lakini basi tena, takwimu nyingi zimepuuzwa na Mama Msiba.
achievement.190.name: [EN] Petrologist
achievement.191.description: Umegundua nguvu zilizofichwa za Wazee - kuanzia sasa na kuendelea, zitakusaidia katika matukio yako.
achievement.191.name: Nguvu Zilizofichwa
achievement.192.description: Hakika unajua jinsi ya kuleta bora katika samani zako na vipande vya mapambo. Mrembo.
achievement.192.name: Naipenda Fancy
achievement.193.description: Unabeba kisu chako cha obsidian kila wakati na hautasita kukitumia. Umechuna ngozi isitoshe - na kubwa zaidi - wakosoaji na ndio: kwa kawaida huwa hawapendezi zaidi ndani. Ni afadhali damu na majivuno na hayo yote ...
achievement.193.name: Ngozi-Kina
achievement.194.description: Staking Vampires na mapepo karibu kugeuka kuwa taaluma yako. Unahakikisha unakusanya hata kiwango kidogo zaidi cha chembe mbaya za vumbi. Jihadharini na silikosisi.
achievement.194.name: Majivu kwa Mavumbi
achievement.196.description: Usijali, hakuna mtu atakayeweza kuichukua kutoka kwako. Pengine.
achievement.196.name: Imehifadhiwa Mbali kwa Usalama
achievement.197.description: Naapa kwa miungu! Hiyo ilikuwa nini?
achievement.197.name: Kitu kiko Humo
achievement.198.description: Awww. Rafiki yako mdogo wa samaki wa dhahabu - ni mzuri, anang'aa na hawezi kulalamika ikiwa ungesahau kumlisha. Hakika ataifurahisha siku yako!
achievement.198.name: Mnyama Mnyama
achievement.199.description: Kurukaruka, kuruka-ruka kwenye theluji - hiyo ndiyo njia ya kufurahisha zaidi! Kufanya nyayo kwa mwendo wa kasi - inafurahisha zaidi kadri unavyoharakisha! Kulamba icicles siku nzima - Majira ya baridi, usitoke kamwe!
achievement.199.name: Snowbunny
achievement.2.description: Lalalala... sasa unajua wimbo wa ibada ulioimbwa Liberty Bay kwa moyo. Sio ngumu sana, kwa kuzingatia kwamba ina maelezo mawili na maneno ya kurudia.
achievement.2.name: Kwaya
achievement.20.description: Unajua kazi za uwindaji na umefanya chache tayari. Kazi nzuri kama mwindaji wa jamii ya Paw & Fur iko mbele!
achievement.20.name: Huntsman
achievement.200.description: Laana mbaya, uchawi mbaya - huoni aibu kuwaadhibu wengine kwa njia zisizo na shaka. Mtu amekupa sura ya kushangaza - sasa hiyo sindano iko wapi tena?
achievement.200.name: Kuhani wa Voodoo ya Giza
achievement.201.description: Nyumbani ndipo uwanja wako wa uwindaji unaoupenda sasa ulipo, na ingawa unaweza kushikilia maeneo fulani zaidi kuliko mengine hukuwahi kuhisi kushikamana vya kutosha kuweza kukaa katika jiji moja kwa muda mrefu. Pakia vitu vyako vyote - ni wakati wa kuendelea tena.
achievement.201.name: Nafsi ya Nomad
achievement.202.description: Ulimwambia Jack ukweli kwa kueleza wewe na Spectulus alifanya makosa wakati wa kujaribu kumshawishi kuwa mtu tofauti kabisa.
achievement.202.name: Ukweli Usemwe
achievement.203.description: Hukumwambia Jack ukweli kuhusu kosa ambalo wewe na Spectulus mlifanya mlipojaribu kumshawishi kuhusu kuwa mtu tofauti kabisa. Ataishi kwa mashaka hadi mwisho wa kuwepo kwake.
achievement.203.name: Humjui Jack
achievement.204.description: Jumuiya ya Mchanganyiko wa Winterberry ya Kichawi kwa hivyo inaheshimu kuendelea kujitolea na juhudi za ajabu katika Msimu wa Msimu wa Vuli wa Mwaka.
achievement.204.name: Berry picker
achievement.205.description: Wewe na marafiki zako mlionyesha wachawi watatu uaminifu wako mara tatu - nina hakika angalau mmoja wao labda anashukuru milele na anajivunia wewe.
achievement.205.name: Rangi za Kweli
achievement.206.description: Umefaulu changamoto ya Kuriks katika maumbo yote yanayowezekana.
achievement.206.name: Mwalimu Shapeshifter
achievement.207.description: Kwa usaidizi wa msaidizi wako mdogo mwenye urafiki, ulichukua zaidi ya vipande 500 vya lami. Umefanya vizuri, Slimer.
achievement.207.name: Slimer
achievement.208.description: Uliua mage mkali katika mnara wake kusini mwa Zao. Tena. Lakini huyu anaendelea kurudi. Lango la sura liliporomoka tena na unajua atarudi hatimaye lakini jamani - jasiri mkali, ni kama kuuliza...
achievement.208.name: Mageslayer
achievement.209.description: Ulipata waogeleaji hamsini adimu wanaometa. Kutoa maiti hizo zote kwa kuzitupa ziwani kulifaa kweli, sivyo? Subiri, hakuna kitu kilichosogea majini sasa hivi...?
achievement.209.name: [EN] Biodegradable
achievement.21.description: Kwa wewe, busu ni zaidi ya kugusa rahisi ya midomo. Unambusu wasichana na mapigo ya kufa sawa kwa upendo usio na kifani na ulikabili kifo na kuzaliwa upya kupitia busu la malkia wa banshee. Wana bahati ni wale ambao wanapata kushiriki wakati wa karibu sana na wewe!
achievement.21.name: Kisser mwenye shauku
achievement.210.description: Hukuiangalia - angalau si kwa muda mrefu sana ... lakini Groam alifanya. Na ukamtuliza. Usimwambie tu rafiki yake Mlevi.
achievement.210.name: Jicho la Kina
achievement.211.description: Viumbe wengi wa kilindi wamepoteza maisha yao kwa mkono wako. Mia tatu wameingia kwenye vilindi vya umilele. Labda unapaswa kuogopa kisasi cha Macho ya Kina.
achievement.211.name: Mvamizi wa Kina
achievement.212.description: Umezima miiba 500! Ulikuwepo wakati Firestarters ilipochukua Shadowthorn. Uliokoa siku - na nyumba ya elves ambayo itajaribu kukuua hata hivyo. Je, haifurahishi kuona kila kitu kikirejeshwa kama ilivyokuwa hapo awali..?
achievement.212.name: [EN] Firefighter
achievement.213.description: Umeweza kuua kulungu zaidi ya mia nne - inaonekana kama wewe ni moja ya sababu kuu ambazo hivi karibuni zitazingatiwa kuwa zimetoweka, njia ya kwenda!
achievement.213.name: Kuwinda Kulungu
achievement.214.description: Sasa wewe ni rafiki wa kifalme wa Askarak, muuaji mkuu.
achievement.214.name: [EN] Askarak Nemesis
achievement.215.description: Sasa wewe ni adui mkuu wa umma wa Shaburak, muuaji mkuu.
achievement.215.name: [EN] Shaburak Nemesis
achievement.216.description: Ulivunja mtungi wa Horesti mara hamsini. Labda hujui hofu au kupuuza tu. Vyovyote iwavyo, "huna woga" kweli.
achievement.216.name: Bila woga
achievement.217.description: Kuna mtu alimpigia simu daktari? Ulipeleka mifuko 100 ya dawa kwa Ottokar wa nyumba maskini ya Venore wakati wa uhitaji mkubwa, umefanya vizuri!
achievement.217.name: Daktari! Daktari!
achievement.218.description: Uliwasaidia kwa kiasi kikubwa wananchi walioteseka wa Venore wakati wa uhitaji mkubwa. Kwa namna fulani bado unahisi kuwa karibu na wahasiriwa wa mlipuko wa homa. Nguo zako zinakufanya kuwa mmoja wao, nafsi moja masikini miongoni mwa watu wasiohesabika.
achievement.218.name: Daktari wa mdomo
achievement.219.description: Ulimshinda yule mwendawazimu, umemshinda mage aliyekasirika - hakuna mtu anayejidhihirisha mwenyewe anayeweza kusimama katika njia yako. Bado unajishughulisha sana na masomo ya kichawi wewe mwenyewe. Kitambaa hiki kinaonyesha idhini hii ya kibinafsi ya sanaa ya uchawi.
achievement.219.name: Uchawi wa Kitambaa cha Mchaji
achievement.22.description: Umejithibitisha kama mwanachama anayestahili wa 'familia' na umefanikiwa kutekeleza misheni nyingi za kijasusi kwa 'mjomba wako' ili kusaidia wafanyabiashara wa Venorea na malengo yao.
achievement.22.name: Wakala wa juu wa AVIN
achievement.221.description: Umevunja kila mguu kati ya miguu minane iliyogandishwa ya Bloodweb. Kama wanasema: kuvunja mguu, na kisha zaidi.
achievement.221.name: Arachnoise
achievement.222.description: Umeshuka kwenye kina kirefu cha lair ya Deathbine na ukaifanyia kazi haraka.
achievement.222.name: Tabia Isiyo na Mizizi
achievement.223.description: Umemuua Esmeralda, panya wa kutisha na mkali zaidi wa panya waliobadilika. Hakuna mtu atakayejua kwamba karibu umepoteza kidole katika mchakato.
achievement.223.name: Ugeuzaji Uliopotoka
achievement.224.description: Kilio cha Ethershreck cha uchungu kiliendelea kusikika sikioni mwako kwa saa nyingi baada ya kuyeyushwa na kuwa hewa nyembamba. Pengine alihamia kwenye ndege nyingine ya kuwepo ... kwa muda.
achievement.224.name: Uchungu Mzuri
achievement.225.description: Moto mkubwa umezimika leo. Ni zamu ya Flameborn kusubiri kuzaliwa upya katika mzunguko wa milele wa maisha na kifo.
achievement.225.name: Moto uliowaka
achievement.226.description: Ulipasua scarab ya zamani ya Fleshcrawler na ukahakikisha kuwa haiingii chini ya ngozi yako.
achievement.226.name: Kifo Cha Kutambaa
achievement.227.description: Ulifunga fundo na mikunjo hai ya Gorgo na kuchukua kichwa chake. Hukuweza kuokoa wahasiriwa wake wengi waliokasirishwa, lakini angalau hukuwa mmoja.
achievement.227.name: Bibi-arusi wa Nyoka
achievement.228.description: Umepata malkia wa buibui aliyefichwa vizuri na ukamkamata katikati ya mlo wake.
achievement.228.name: Hakuna Kujificha Tena
achievement.229.description: Inaonekana milango ya kuzimu inabidi kubaki bila ulinzi kwa muda. Kerberos, helhound hodari, alipoteza kichwa chake. Wote watatu.
achievement.229.name: Milango ya Kuzimu
achievement.23.description: Nguvu ya msichana! Iwe wewe ni mwanamke au la, umethibitisha uaminifu kamili na nia ya kuweka maisha yako hatarini kwa ajili ya brigedi ya wasichana ya Carlin.
achievement.23.name: Wakala wa juu wa CGB
achievement.230.description: Kama muuaji wa Leviathan, nyoka mkubwa wa baharini, ufalme wake wa chini ya maji sasa uko chini ya utawala wako.
achievement.230.name: Mungu wa Bahari Aliyezama
achievement.231.description: Ribstride hana hatua tena. Ingawa alikuwa na mbavu chache sana.
achievement.231.name: Spareribs kwa Chakula cha jioni
achievement.232.description: Ulikaribia kufanya urafiki na Shardhead... kabla hajafa. Mtu maskini anaonekana tu kuvutia vurugu na tabia yake ya baridi.
achievement.232.name: Kuvunja Barafu
achievement.233.description: Kichwa cha Stonecracker kilikuwa laini zaidi kuliko mawe aliyokurushia.
achievement.233.name: Umenipasua tu!
achievement.234.description: Umeondoa mawingu ya gesi ya Sulfur Scuttler na kuifanya hewa katika pango lake kuwa bora kidogo ... angalau kwa muda.
achievement.234.name: Kitu Kinanuka
achievement.235.description: Umemtundika mnyama mkubwa wa Damu kwa pembe zake mwenyewe.
achievement.235.name: Mshikaki wa Nyama
achievement.236.description: Wengi hawapo tena, lakini wapo wangapi zaidi? Mtu hawezi kamwe kujua.
achievement.236.name: Moja Chini
achievement.237.description: Umeshinda Spawn Mbaya na moyo wake wa nyoka.
achievement.237.name: Kuanguka kwa Hising
achievement.238.description: Mjane Mzee alianguka mawindo ya ujuzi wako wa juu wa uwindaji.
achievement.238.name: Kukabwa na Sumu Yake
achievement.239.description: Umechafua sakafu ya msitu na damu nyekundu ya Snapper.
achievement.239.name: Damu-Nyekundu ya Snapper
achievement.24.description: Njama na siri zilizo wazi ndio mkate wako wa kila siku. Umeonyesha uaminifu kwa taji la Thai kupitia ujasiri wako unapokabiliana na maadui na kukamilisha misheni ya kijasusi. Wewe ni wakala bora wa TBI.
achievement.24.name: Wakala wa juu wa TBI
achievement.240.description: Umekata mikunjo mingi leo. Thul alirudishwa mahali alipo.
achievement.240.name: Rudi kwenye shimo
achievement.241.description: Umewakabili na kuwashinda wakubwa wengi hodari wa jamii ya Paw na Fur iliyokutuma kuua. Peke yako. Uwindaji ulioje!
achievement.241.name: Amevuna Manyoya Mengi
achievement.242.description: Umesimamisha wizi wa benki na kurudisha begi limejaa dhahabu. Ni vizuri kujua bado kuna Watibia halali kama wewe karibu.
achievement.242.name: Mpataji Mwaminifu
achievement.243.description: Kama si wewe, benki kadhaa za Tibia zingekuwa zimefilisika kufikia sasa. Endelea kuwafukuza wezi wa benki na hakuna mtu atakayekuwa na wasiwasi juu ya uchumi wa Tibia!
achievement.243.name: Goldhunter
achievement.244.description: Umegundua safu ya nyayo kubwa na tembo waliotisha wanaokimbia kila mahali. Je, inawezekana kwamba mungu wa ajabu wa nyani anarandaranda msituni?
achievement.244.name: Njia ya Ape Mungu
achievement.245.description: Huyo HAKUWA buibui mkubwa. Kuna uchawi unafanya kazi hapa.
achievement.245.name: Mtu Amechoka
achievement.246.description: Huwezi kuweka siri, sivyo? Halafu tena, unatimiza wajibu wako kwa Malkia wa Carlin kama raia halali. Hilo ni jambo zuri, sivyo...?
achievement.246.name: Mpiga Firimbi
achievement.247.description: Wyda inaonekana kuwa kweli, kweli kuchoka. Pia uligundua kuwa hahitaji kabisa dawa hizo zote za damu ambazo wasafiri walimletea. Bado, alikuwa mzuri vya kutosha kuchukua moja kutoka kwako na akakupa kitu kizuri sana kwa kubadilishana.
achievement.247.name: Hazina Zilizochanwa
achievement.248.description: Ulijiunga na sherehe za Sikukuu ya Wafalme na kumlipa Mfalme Tibianus heshima zako. Sasa, nenda kwenye sherehe!
achievement.248.name: Somo la uaminifu
achievement.249.description: Ulifanikiwa kukamata samaki katika eneo ambalo kwa kawaida halibebi maji. Kila kitu kinaweza kubadilika, labda ...
achievement.249.name: Mvuvi wa Jangwa
achievement.25.description: Pakia vifaa vyako vya upelelezi na uwe tayari kwa misheni hatari katika huduma ya wakala wa siri. Umeonyesha unataka - lakini unaweza kuifanya kweli? Muda utasema.
achievement.25.name: Wakala wa Siri
achievement.251.description: Ulionyesha Noodles njia ya kurudi nyumbani. Je, itachukua muda gani hadi awe huru tena? Mbwa huyo lazima awe amechoka sana kwenye chumba cha enzi kwa sasa.
achievement.251.name: Mtunza Mbwa
achievement.252.description: Ulishuhudia kuyeyuka kwa Svargrond na ukavuna mbegu adimu kutoka kwa mimea ya ajabu ya barafu. Lazima ziwe nzuri kwa kitu.
achievement.252.name: Mvunaji Barafu
achievement.253.description: Wewe ni mwanafikra mzuri na umeweza kuunda maua ya milele. Wanaweza kuwa maarufu kwa watu wote ambao hawajabarikiwa na kidole gumba cha kijani au kusahau tu.
achievement.253.name: [EN] Preservationist
achievement.254.description: Umegundua kambi tatu za kuhamahama na kuiba vifaa vyao. Kweli, labda unaweza kuzitumia vizuri zaidi kuliko zinavyoweza.
achievement.254.name: Mwizi wa Kifua
achievement.255.description: Umepata shimo la siri kwenye tambarare zilizofurika na kuua wakazi wake kadhaa. Na sasa una miguu ya mvua.
achievement.255.name: Chini Mfereji
achievement.256.description: Umenusurika kwenye mlipuko wa Hellgorge na umepata njia kupitia miali ya moto na lava. Umeweza hata kuua fireborn wachache njiani.
achievement.256.name: Moto kutoka Duniani
achievement.257.description: Matendo yako yanaanza kuleta mabadiliko. Umepofusha antena za mzinga mara nyingi kiasi cha kuwa kero kwake.
achievement.257.name: Usumbufu mdogo
achievement.258.description: Katika vita dhidi ya mzinga, juhudi zako za kuupofusha huanza kuzaa matunda. Matendo yako yamepofusha mzinga kwa ukali na huluki inaonekana kufahamu kuwa kuna kitu hatari kinachotokea.
achievement.258.name: Dazzler
achievement.259.description: Umeweka muda mwingi na nguvu katika kuweka mzinga bila kujua kinachotokea kwenye Quirefang. Mzinga ulijifunza kuogopa matendo yako. Bila shaka ingekuponda kwa nguvu zake zote ... ikiwa ingekupata tu!
achievement.259.name: Mzinga Blinder
achievement.26.description: Wewe ni fundi mago-mekanika. Sayansi na uchawi hufanya kazi pamoja machoni pako - na ingawa labda ulilipa gharama nyingi zisizo sahihi ulipokuwa unafanya kazi kwa Telas, unaweza kuwa na ujuzi wa kutosha kuunda golem yako mwenyewe sasa.
achievement.26.name: Golem katika Gia
achievement.260.description: Umezoea kuzunguka mara kwa mara kwenye mfumo wa tumbo la mzinga. Matendo yako yamesababisha mzinga matatizo ya kwanza ya usagaji chakula.
achievement.260.name: Hickup
achievement.261.description: Huchoshi kamwe, unashambulia viungo vya ndani vya mzinga mkubwa. Mashambulizi yako kwenye mfumo wa usagaji chakula wa mzinga huanza kusababisha matatizo.
achievement.261.name: Kiungulia
achievement.262.description: Ulivuruga sana usagaji wa mzinga. Mzinga lazima hakika umwone daktari. Inaonekana umethibitisha kuwa zaidi ya inaweza kumeza.
achievement.262.name: Kidonda cha Tumbo
achievement.263.description: Mzinga unapaswa kupigwa vita kwa nguvu na kuu, kuzuia askari wake ni hatua ya kwanza tu. Ulisimamisha kwa bidii vinyweleo vya mzinga ili kueneza wapiganaji wake.
achievement.263.name: Mpandaji
achievement.264.description: Unapata uzoefu zaidi na zaidi katika kuharibu usambazaji wa vikosi vya adui. Matendo yako yalisababisha mzinga matatizo makubwa ya ngozi.
achievement.264.name: Chunusi
achievement.265.description: Vita hushindwa na wale ambao wana ugavi bora wa askari. Wanajeshi wa mzinga wamepata pigo kubwa kutokana na vitendo vyako. Ulikatiza kujazwa tena na mzinga wa askari kwa kudumu na kwa ukali.
achievement.265.name: Suppressor
achievement.266.description: Kwa kuua viumbe vya mzinga na kupata silaha kwa misheni zaidi, ulianza njia nzuri ya vita. Ulikusanya chitin nyingi zilizoyeyushwa ili kusambaza tena juhudi za vita.
achievement.266.name: Mkusanyaji
achievement.267.description: Uhitaji wa vifaa mara nyingi huamua juu ya hasara au ushindi. Juhudi zako zisizochoka za kusambaza tena rasilimali huweka vita dhidi ya mzinga kuendelea.
achievement.267.name: Msambazaji
achievement.268.description: Umekuwa na uwezo na ufanisi katika kukusanya dutu inayohitajika kupigana na mzinga. Unakaribia kunusa kama chitin iliyoyeyushwa na Hive Born wanaweza kusimulia watoto wao hadithi za kutisha kukuhusu ikiwa wangeweza kuzungumza.
achievement.268.name: [EN] Chitin Bane
achievement.269.description: Umethibitisha kuwa unaweza kupiga bora zaidi ya mzinga. Umesababisha uvunjaji wa ahadi wa kwanza katika ulinzi wa mzinga
achievement.269.name: Mlinzi Muuaji
achievement.27.description: Mashairi, mistari, nyimbo na mashairi ambayo umekariri mara nyingi. Umepita mlango wa siri, mjuzi wa hadithi za zamani. Hata elves umewaacha wakiwa wamevutiwa, kwa hivyo inaonekana umebarikiwa kweli.
achievement.27.name: Mshairi Mshindi wa Tuzo
achievement.270.description: Wapiganaji wenye nguvu zaidi wa mzinga waliuawa na wewe na kadhaa. Mzinga si salama tena kwa sababu ya matendo yako.
achievement.270.name: Mzinga Infiltrator
achievement.271.description: Ufanisi na hatari, umepata uzoefu mkubwa katika kupambana na nguvu za wasomi wa mzinga. Karibu bila mkono mmoja, umewaua walio bora zaidi wa Hive Born na unaishi kusimulia hadithi.
achievement.271.name: [EN] Exterminator
achievement.272.description: Hata katika miundo ya ndani kabisa ya mzinga, ulianza kupiga dhidi ya adui hodari. Matendo yako pengine tayari yameuumiza kichwa mzinga.
achievement.272.name: Maumivu ya kichwa
achievement.273.description: Uharibifu uliosababisha sasa unaweza kuhisiwa katika mzinga mzima. Ghasia inayofuata hatua yako ilisababisha mkanganyiko mkubwa katika ufahamu wa mzinga.
achievement.273.name: Kuchanganyikiwa
achievement.274.description: Umeharibu kiasi kikubwa cha vituo muhimu vya neva vya mzinga na kusababisha uharibifu mkubwa kwa ufahamu wa mzinga. Labda unasababisha ndoto mbaya za mzinga.
achievement.274.name: Manic
achievement.276.name: Hitilafu ya Urambazaji
achievement.277.description: Umepata msafiri wa mashariki Yasir na umeweza kufanya biashara naye - hata kama ulikuwa hauelewi lugha yake.
achievement.277.name: Si, Ariki!
achievement.278.description: Ulimaliza maisha ya zaidi ya Walinzi mia tatu wa Deepling Guards. Sio mlezi kabisa wa Deeplings, sivyo?
achievement.278.name: Kuanguka kwa Mlezi
achievement.279.description: Ulinyamazisha nyimbo za vita kwenye kilindi cheusi kwa kufyeka zaidi ya Deepling Spellingers mia tatu.
achievement.279.name: Wimbo wa Kifo
achievement.28.description: Unaweza kushughulikia ala yoyote ya muziki uliyopewa - na kwa hakika uweze kutoa sauti ya kupendeza nayo. Wewe ni mgeni aliyekaribishwa na mburudishaji katika tavern nyingi.
achievement.28.name: Mwanamuziki
achievement.280.description: Kwa kuondoa angalau Deepling Warriors mia tatu ulitoa pigo kubwa kwa majeshi yaliyokusanyika ya kina.
achievement.280.name: Wakazi wa kina
achievement.281.description: Unakata jiwe lako la kwanza - na lina jina lako mwenyewe! Sasa hiyo itakuwa zawadi nzuri! Hii haifanyi kuwa Moyo wa "kweli" wa Bahari, hata hivyo ...
achievement.281.name: Mkata Vito
achievement.282.description: Ulisafiri kwenye kina kirefu cha ulimwengu huu. Uliingia kwenye weusi wa bahari kuu ili kushinda eneo la Deeplings. Suti hii na ikukumbushe uzuri wa ajabu hapa chini.
achievement.282.name: [EN] Spolium Profundis
achievement.283.description: Mapigano mengi na bidii isiyochosha katika vita dhidi ya mzinga hukupa uzoefu wa kumaliza mavazi yako na sehemu ya mwisho iliyobaki. Mavazi yako ya chitin ni ushuhuda wa ujuzi wako na kujitolea kwa sababu hiyo.
achievement.283.name: Bane wa Mzinga
achievement.285.description: Uzoefu wako wa thamani katika kupigana na mzinga hukuruhusu kuongeza kipande kingine cha silaha kwenye vazi lako la chitin ili kudhibitisha kujitolea kwako kwa sababu hiyo.
achievement.285.name: Mkongwe wa Vita Mzinga
achievement.286.description: Umeshiriki kwa kiasi kikubwa katika vita vya mizinga, kwamba unaweza kuunda silaha za muda kutoka kwa mabaki ya mizinga iliyokufa ambayo inaweza kupatikana kwenye mzinga mkubwa, ili kuonyesha ujuzi wako.
achievement.286.name: Mpiganaji wa Hive
achievement.287.description: Umenyamazisha kilio cha milele cha Hemming.
achievement.287.name: Vipi Kimya
achievement.288.description: Hakuna tena hofu na ndoto mbaya. Ulimchoma Tormentor hadi kufa kwa mguu wake wa komeo.
achievement.288.name: Ndoto Imeisha
achievement.289.description: Ulimfuta Fazzrah - zzeemzz kana kwamba sasa wewe ndiye nahodha.
achievement.289.name: [EN] Zzztill Zzztanding!
achievement.29.description: Unajua Banuta anapenda sehemu ya nyuma ya mkono wako na ni hodari katika kuharibu mikoba na mikojo. Kuonekana kwa nyayo kubwa hakukuzuii kuzuru maeneo yasiyojulikana pia.
achievement.29.name: Rafiki wa Nyani
achievement.290.name: Alikanyaga Kidole Kikubwa
achievement.291.name: Kapow!
achievement.292.description: [SW] You gave zzze draken a tazte of your finizzzing move.
achievement.292.name: Ingiza zze Draken!
achievement.293.description: Mwili wa Bretzecutioner uligongwa tu. Wewe ni mfalme wa kweli wa pete!
achievement.293.name: Mfalme wa Pete
achievement.294.description: Ulimshinda Zanakefu ambaye hajafa na kumrudisha kwenye giza lililomzaa.
achievement.294.name: Kurudi kutoka kwa Wafu
achievement.295.description: Umekabiliana na kuwashinda kila mmoja wa wakubwa hodari wa jamii ya Paw na Fur iliyokutuma kuua. Peke yako. Uwindaji ulioje!
achievement.295.name: Imechomwa manyoya yote
achievement.297.description: Unasaidia katika kuwashinda Orcs wavamizi kwa kuharibu kambi yao ya vita pamoja na kiongozi wao. Umwagaji damu wa Bibby binafsi...
achievement.297.name: Umwagaji damu wa Bibby
achievement.298.description: Ulisafisha ardhi kutokana na kero ya miguu minane kwa kuwashinda Mamma Longlegs mara tatu. Hatarudi hivi karibuni ... au atarudi?
achievement.298.name: Nestling
achievement.299.description: Ulifanya hivyo! Uliwashawishi mbilikimo waliojitenga kukukubali kama mmoja wa Bigfoots wao. Sasa uko tayari kuwasaidia. Kwa miguu mikubwa misheni mikubwa inayoonekana kuja.
achievement.299.name: Kuwa Bigfoot
achievement.3.description: Muuza maziwa ni nani? Wewe ni!
achievement.3.name: Mkamuaji maziwa
achievement.30.description: Ramani yako ni rafiki yako - daima iko kwenye mfuko wako wa nyuma na kufunikwa na alama nyingi za maeneo ya kuvutia na muhimu. Mtu anaweza kusema kwamba unaweza kupotea bila hiyo - lakini kwa bahati nzuri hakuna njia ya kuiondoa kutoka kwako.
achievement.30.name: Eneo
achievement.300.description: Unafikiri mbilikimo wanaanza kukupenda. Hatua ndogo kwa Bigfoot lakini hatua kubwa kwa ubinadamu.
achievement.300.name: Msaidizi Mdogo wa Gnome
achievement.301.description: mbilikimo ni joto juu yako. Mmoja wao au wawili wanaweza kujisumbua kukumbuka jina lako. Unaruhusiwa kufikia gnomebase alpha yao. Uko tayari kuweka miguu yako mikubwa kwa ujasiri katika maeneo ambayo watu wachache wametembea hapo awali.
achievement.301.name: Rafiki wa Gnome
achievement.302.description: Umekuwa jina la nyumbani katika jamii ya wahuni! Jina lako linatajwa na gnomes zaidi ya mara moja. Bila shaka kwa kawaida na akina mama wajinga ambao watoto wao wanakataa kula supu ya uyoga, lakini kwa hakika unafanya maendeleo makubwa sana.
achievement.302.name: Gnomelike
achievement.303.description: Umetimiza kile ambacho wanadamu wachache watawahi kufanya: ulivutia sana mbilikimo. Hili linaweza lisibadilishe mtazamo wao juu ya ubinadamu kwa ujumla, lakini angalau unaweza kuoga katika heshima ya kijinga! Na usisahau sasa unaruhusiwa kuingia katika maeneo ya vita!
achievement.303.name: Mbilikimo wa heshima
achievement.304.description: Ulileta fuwele mbili za upendo pamoja. Labda wanaweza hata kumwita mmoja wa watoto wao baada yako. Inasikitisha sana kwamba umesahau kuacha kadi yako ya kupiga simu.
achievement.304.name: Fuwele katika Upendo
achievement.305.description: Pete-a-ding! Umetembelea karakana ya golem na umetoa mkono katika kuzirekebisha. Kujua hao golems ni salama inafaa michubuko yote, sivyo?
achievement.305.name: Tinker mbadala
achievement.306.description: Baada ya kuwinda uyoga sahihi na spores zao unaanza kujisikia kama uyoga mwenyewe. Mara chache zaidi na unaweza kuanza kufikiria kama uyoga, ni nani anayejua?
achievement.306.name: [EN] Spore Hunter
achievement.307.description: Vidole vilivyoungua na kuwasha mapafu ni bei ndogo kwa kuleta mbilikimo hao jiwe chafu na kukaribia kuuawa! Mama yako alikuonya kuwa bora uwe mkulima.
achievement.307.name: Kusaga Tena
achievement.308.description: Umeona yote. Imefanya yote. Nguvu yako isiyozuilika ilipita kwenye shimo na ukawashinda mabwana zao. Bila kusahau nyara ya thamani uliyochukua! Sasa acha kusoma hii na endelea kuwinda! Muda ni pesa baada ya yote!
achievement.308.name: Kisafishaji cha shimo
achievement.309.description: Kwa hivyo ulirekebisha mwanga wa fuwele kadhaa kwa hizo mbilikimo. Nini kinafuata? Kukaa kwa wiki kwenye kitanda cha uyoga kama uyoga wa muda?
achievement.309.name: Mlinzi wa Kioo
achievement.31.description: Umethibitisha kuwa mshirika muhimu wa Marid, na Gabel alikukaribisha kufanya biashara na Haroun na Nah'Bob wakati wowote unapotaka. Ingawa vita vya Djinn bado havijaisha, Marid hawawezi kushindwa na wewe kwa upande wao.
achievement.31.name: Marid Ally
achievement.310.description: Hakika ulifurahia mauaji kama kawaida. Lakini sehemu iliyo na cheche bado inakupa mtetemo ... au ni kwamba kuna malipo fulani iliyobaki kwako?
achievement.310.name: Niite Sparky
achievement.311.description: Bigfoot moja ilishinda zaidi ya maelfu ya futi ndogo. Labda gnomes sio sawa na saizi ni muhimu?
achievement.311.name: Mguu Mmoja Vs. Nyingi
achievement.312.description: mbilikimo waliamua nguruwe wao kuhitaji baadhi ya chakula cha kipekee na wewe alikuwa na kufanya kazi zote chafu - lakini si nguruwe nguruwe adorable?
achievement.312.name: Nguruwe Mchuzi
achievement.313.description: Ulimuua balozi wa shimo kwamba mara nyingi wapate kufikiria kutuma mwingine. Labda hiyo siku moja itasimamisha uingiliaji zaidi.
achievement.313.name: Kinga ya Kidiplomasia
achievement.314.description: Umewahi kujiuliza jinsi anavyotokea tena na tena? Unajali tu uporaji, sivyo? Gotcha!
achievement.314.name: Kuanguka kwa Walioanguka
achievement.315.description: Tena na tena Deathstrike imeanguka kwa uwezo wako. Labda ni wakati wa watu kukupigia simu "Deathstrike" kuanzia sasa na kuendelea.
achievement.315.name: Kifo kwenye Mgomo
achievement.316.description: Uso wa adui umefichuliwa. Umekumbana na mojawapo ya 'zilizo hapa chini' na ukanusurika. Zaidi ya hayo, uliweza kumuua mnyama na kuthibitisha mara moja na kwa wote kwamba adui anaweza kupigwa.
achievement.316.name: Kifo kutoka Chini
achievement.317.description: mbilikimo aliyeanguka amekufa na haki inatendeka. Lakini ni nini mbilikimo alinong'ona na pumzi yake ya mwisho? Yeye ni baba yako???
achievement.317.name: Bane ya Gnomebane
achievement.318.description: Shambulio kuu la Kifo limekufa! Hadithi moja imekufa na uko njiani kuwa mtu mwenyewe.
achievement.318.name: Mgomo wa Mwisho
achievement.319.description: Kuona kamasi kuziba hufanya moyo wako kucheza na huwezi kupinga kuona nini inaficha. Goo goo mbali!
achievement.319.name: Mchezaji wa Goo Goo
achievement.32.description: Ingawa Efreet alikukaribisha tu kwa kusita na kukuona kama "binadamu tu" kwa muda mrefu, uliweza kumvutia Malor na kupata heshima yake na chaguzi za biashara na djinns za kijani.
achievement.32.name: [EN] Efreet Ally
achievement.320.description: Hatimaye ndoto yako ya kuwa uyoga unaotembea imetimia ... Hapana, subiri kidogo!
achievement.320.name: [EN] Funghitastic
achievement.321.description: Ikiwa gnomes wangekuambia kuwa silaha za fuwele zinaweza kuonekana, labda ungebadilisha chupi yako kwa wakati.
achievement.321.name: [EN] Crystal Clear
achievement.322.description: Umeachilia mbilikimo wako wa ndani na kuua baadhi ya vitisho vya kutisha ambavyo gnomekind amewahi kukabili. Sasa unaweza kuja na kwenda kwenye maeneo ya vita kama inavyokupendeza. Maadui wa gnomekind hawatakuwa salama tena.
achievement.322.name: Sanaa ya Vita ya Gnomish
achievement.324.description: Ulishinda changamoto ya pepo na kushinda ... sasa onyesha mafanikio yako kwa mtindo!
achievement.324.name: Kujitolea kwa Kweli
achievement.325.description: Kumsaidia goblin maskini, mjinga kulisha watoto wake na wake wenye njaa hujisikia vizuri ... ikiwa ungeondoa tu hisia ya ajabu kwamba unakosa kitu.
achievement.325.name: Meneja wa Kazi
achievement.326.description: Kusaidia mpango wa wagonjwa wa Omrabas kufufua kulikufanya uchimbe njia yako kupitia kumbi zilizojaa damu za Drefia. Labda bora alishindwa!
achievement.326.name: [EN] Gravedigger
achievement.327.description: Ulisafisha nafsi yako katika kumtumikia Mwenye kutubu na kujisafisha nafsi yako katika kukamilisha kazi zote katika siku moja ya kazi.
achievement.327.name: Mwenye kutubu
achievement.328.description: Umeweza kubadilisha, kuboresha na kutoa blade yako kuwa hali bora na umejithibitisha kuwa unastahili katika ulimwengu wa ndoto mbaya.
achievement.328.name: [EN] Umbral Swordsman
achievement.33.description: Ndoto - ni ukweli wako? Maono ya ajabu, saa zinazoyoma, kwenda kulala na kuamka mahali pengine kabisa - hiyo ilikuwa safari fulani, lakini una hakika kwamba uliifurahia.
achievement.33.name: [EN] Lucid Dreamer
achievement.331.description: Umesaidia mbilikimo za mwiba katika kulinda mapango na kuchunguza kina cha kutosha cha mwanga ili kukuletea vazi kamili la wagunduzi wa pango. Umefanya vizuri!
achievement.331.name: Mkamilishaji wa Pango
achievement.332.description: Umeweza kubadilisha, kuboresha na kumtoa muuaji wako kuwa hali bora na umejithibitisha kuwa unastahili katika ulimwengu wa ndoto mbaya.
achievement.332.name: [EN] Umbral Bladelord
achievement.333.description: Umeweza kubadilisha, kuboresha na kutoa shoka lako kuwa hali bora na umethibitisha kuwa unastahili katika ulimwengu wa ndoto mbaya.
achievement.333.name: [EN] Umbral Headsman
achievement.334.description: Umeweza kubadilisha, kuboresha na kutoa chopper yako kuwa hali bora na umejidhihirisha kuwa unastahili katika ulimwengu wa ndoto mbaya.
achievement.334.name: Mnyongaji wa Umbral
achievement.335.description: Umeweza kubadilisha, kuboresha na kutoa rungu lako kuwa hali bora na umejidhihirisha kuwa unastahili katika ulimwengu wa ndoto mbaya.
achievement.335.name: [EN] Umbral Brawler
achievement.336.description: Umeweza kubadilisha, kuboresha na kutoa nyundo yako kuwa hali bora na umejidhihirisha kuwa unastahili katika ulimwengu wa ndoto mbaya.
achievement.336.name: [EN] Umbral Berserker
achievement.337.description: Umeweza kubadilisha, kuboresha na kutoa upinde wako kuwa hali bora na umejidhihirisha kuwa unastahili katika ulimwengu wa ndoto mbaya.
achievement.337.name: Upinde wa Umbral
achievement.338.description: Umeweza kubadilisha, kuboresha na kutoa upinde wako kuwa hali bora na umejithibitisha kuwa unastahili katika ulimwengu wa ndoto mbaya.
achievement.338.name: [EN] Umbral Marksman
achievement.339.description: Umeweza kubadilisha, kuboresha na kutoa kitabu chako cha spelling kuwa hali kuu na umethibitisha kuwa unastahili katika ulimwengu wa jinamizi.
achievement.339.name: [EN] Umbral Harbinger
achievement.34.description: Umetembelea sehemu ambazo watu wengi hawazijui hata majina. Kukusanya sampuli za mimea, zoologic na ectoplasmic ni biashara yako ya kila siku na uko tayari kugundua upeo mpya kila wakati.
achievement.34.name: Mchunguzi
achievement.340.description: Umeweza kubadilisha, kuboresha na kutoa kila aina ya silaha kuwa hali bora na umejithibitisha kuwa unastahili katika ulimwengu wa ndoto mbaya. Heshima!
achievement.340.name: Mwalimu wa Umbral
achievement.341.description: Ulikusanya jumbe zote za ajabu za chupa kuzunguka kisiwa cha Roshamuul na ukapata mabaki ya mwenzi wa kwanza. Muda utaonyesha ikiwa hadithi yake ya kutengeneza pete mbaya ni ya kweli.
achievement.341.name: [EN] Nevermending Story
achievement.342.description: Ugunduzi ulioje wa kisayansi - WANAwasiliana kweli! Kwa kutumia tabia zao za mawasiliano dhidi yao, ulivuta kundi kubwa la vinyamazishaji mbali na kuta za Roshamuul.
achievement.342.name: Kuvutia Ukimya
achievement.343.description: Hukuonyesha dalili zozote za kujisalimisha kwa mtazamo wowote... unapata picha. Hata mia moja yao hawakuwa tishio kwako.
achievement.343.name: Usijisalimishe Kamwe
achievement.344.description: Umerekebisha ndoto nyingi zilizovunjika na kwa hivyo, ndoto ya Roshamuul inasimuliwa kwa usalama tena na tena.
achievement.344.name: Ndoto Wright
achievement.345.description: Umezisafisha nchi kwa mambo mengi ya kutisha. Hakika unajua jinsi ya kumaliza ndoto mbaya: kwa nguvu, ndivyo!
achievement.345.name: Kukomesha Hofu
achievement.346.description: Unajua njia yako, katika ndoto na kuamka. Na jinsi ya kutengeneza chai inayovuka mipaka ya dhamiri.
achievement.346.name: [EN] Sleepwalking
achievement.347.description: Haijalishi ni kelele gani ungesikia ... ndoto, ndoto mbaya, udanganyifu - hakuna kitu ambacho huwezi kushinda. Wewe ni Mwangalizi wa kweli wa Ndoto.
achievement.347.name: Mwangalizi wa Ndoto
achievement.348.description: Gaz'haragoth ... siku ya kukumbuka! Ulimwengu wako ulikamilisha jambo kubwa sana - na umekuwa sehemu yake!
achievement.348.name: Mapumziko ya Magereza
achievement.349.description: Baada ya vita kama hii unajua marafiki zako ni akina nani.
achievement.349.name: [EN] Noblesse Obliterated
achievement.35.description: Hata mazingira mabaya ya chini ya maji hayakuzuii kufanya jukumu lako kwa Jumuiya ya Wachunguzi. Kuchunguza eneo la Quara ni kipande cha keki kwako.
achievement.35.name: Scout ya Bahari
achievement.350.description: Kupitia ari ya sayansi na uchunguzi, umegundua jinsi ya kuingia katika maficho ya siri ya Dk Merlay mashuhuri.
achievement.350.name: Msingi, Mpendwa Wangu
achievement.351.description: Kwa kutoa huduma nyingi kwa jiji la Rathleton umepandishwa cheo hadi Commoner.
achievement.351.name: [EN] Rathleton Commoner
achievement.352.description: Kwa kutoa huduma nyingi kwa jiji la Rathleton umepandishwa cheo hadi kuwa Mkaaji.
achievement.352.name: Mwenyeji wa Rathleton
achievement.353.description: Kwa kutoa huduma nyingi kwa jiji la Rathleton umepandishwa cheo hadi kuwa Raia.
achievement.353.name: Rathleton Mwananchi
achievement.354.description: Umetimiza minyororo 10 au zaidi mfululizo mfululizo! Hiyo ni kuua angalau viumbe 39 kwa mpangilio sahihi - sasa hiyo ni combinatorics!
achievement.354.name: [EN] Combo Master
achievement.355.description: Ingawa unaweza kuwa umeepuka tishio kubwa kwa Rathleton, amani hii ya jamaa inaweza kudumu kwa muda. Angalau umeondoa nguo kutoka kwa baadhi ya watu maskini ambao wameanguka kwenye mawindo ya kifo cha kuhani Shagron.
achievement.355.name: Mhandisi wa Glooth
achievement.356.description: Uligundua Mwamba wa Simba, ukafaulu majaribio ya kuingia ndani ya patakatifu na hatimaye ukafichua siri za hekalu lililozikwa. Uliweka kichwa chako kwenye kinywa cha simba na ukanusurika.
achievement.356.name: Mpekuzi wa Tundu la Simba
achievement.357.description: Adventure ni jina lako la kati. Ulitumia muda mwingi katika nchi hatari na umeona mambo ambayo wengine wanayaota tu. Unajua njia yako huko Tibia - wewe ni mwanariadha mwenye uzoefu sasa. Na safari yako ndio imeanza!
achievement.357.name: Mchezaji Msimu
achievement.358.description: Una akili iliyo tayari kutoa hitimisho la kushangaza ambalo linakaidi sheria za mantiki na ukweli wa kando. Au labda ni nadhani tu ya bahati - au uzembe wa adventurous?
achievement.358.name: [EN] Mind the Step!
achievement.359.description: Kwa kutoa huduma nyingi kwa jiji la Rathleton umepandishwa cheo hadi Squire.
achievement.359.name: [EN] Rathleton Squire
achievement.36.description: Wow - hiyo ilikuwa nini? Hujui jinsi ulivyoishia hapa, lakini kwa namna fulani ulifanya. Jinsi ya kutoka kwa Beregar hadi Kazordoon kwa haraka - hilo ni jambo ambalo watu wadogo wangependa kujua, lakini huna uhakika kabisa jinsi ya kuizalisha tena.
achievement.36.name: Uwezekano Pathfinder
achievement.360.description: Alihifadhi karanga kwa umakini? Huyo alikuwa ni profesa wa ajabu kweli.
achievement.360.name: Nut ya Profesa
achievement.361.description: Umeshinda kivunja ukuta na kuokoa mmea wa glooth.
achievement.361.name: Kiwanda dhidi ya Minos
achievement.362.description: Umeshinda mdudu wa tetemeko - na unashangaa ni aina gani ya samaki utaweza kupata kwa chambo kama hicho.
achievement.362.name: Rumble katika mmea
achievement.363.description: Umeshinda bomu la glooth na kukata wanyama wengi wa chuma kwenye njia yako.
achievement.363.name: Robo Chop
achievement.364.description: Umeepuka mtego unaowaka wa lava, Profesa Maxxen amekuwekea - Kapteni Caveworm anajivunia!
achievement.364.name: [SW] Go with da Lava Flow
achievement.365.description: Uliona Bustani za Crystal na uzuri wao wote wa kushangaza na ukanusurika na wanyama wakubwa wa kuvutia huko. Mwishowe uligundua ubaya mkubwa na kuuharibu kwa msaada wa banshee ambaye hata hakujua msaada wake.
achievement.365.name: Kuomboleza kwa Banshee
achievement.366.description: Wewe ni mtu wa umma. Au ya utangazaji mzuri angalau. Kupitia juhudi zako za kutangaza kitambaa kisichopitisha hewa, Zeronex bado inaweza kukombolewa - na Rathleton bado inaweza kuona Gloud Ship yake ya kwanza inayofanya kazi.
achievement.366.name: Utangazaji
achievement.367.description: [EN] By restoring the Everhungry Altar, you charmed the Fire-Feathered Sea Serpent back into its fitful sleep, twenty miles beneath the sea.
achievement.367.name: Nyoka Charmer
achievement.368.description: [EN] Your adventurous way through countless dragon lairs earned you a pretty treasure - and surely the enmity of many a dragon.
achievement.368.name: [EN] Hoard of the Dragon
achievement.37.description: Joto, mwenye manyoya na mkunjo - ingawa dubu yule yule uliyemkumbatia labda angekupasua vipande vipande ikiwa alikuwa na fahamu, alikukumbusha juu ya dubu yule mzee ambaye alilala kitandani mwako wakati ungali mdogo.
achievement.37.name: Bearhugger
achievement.370.description: [EN] You found a lost sheep and thus a steady source of black wool. But careful: don't get entangled.
achievement.370.name: [EN] Little Ball of Wool
achievement.371.description: [EN] You made some efforts to bring a little more light into the world. And what a nice present you got in return!
achievement.371.name: [EN] Luminous Kitty
achievement.372.description: [EN] By setting the right tone you convinced a crystal wolf to accompany you. Remember it is made of crystal, though, so be careful in a banshee's presence.
achievement.372.name: [EN] The Right Tone
achievement.373.description: [EN] Having a loyal friend alongside is comforting to every adventurer. If only this lad was not so stubborn...
achievement.373.name: Loyal Lad
achievement.374.description: [EN] It's not really a dragon, but rather a kind of chimera. Nonetheless a decent mount to impress any passer-by.
achievement.374.name: [EN] Dragon Mimicry
achievement.375.description: [EN] The Muggy Plains are a dangerous place, often raided by dragons. But that was your luck: thus you found this scaly little guy.
achievement.375.name: [EN] Scales and Tail
achievement.376.description: [EN] There are many delusions and phantasms in the desert. You saw a false oasis with fruit-bearing palm trees. Instead of water and refreshment, however, you found a dromedary in the end. What a useful Fata Morgana!
achievement.376.name: [EN] Fata Morgana
achievement.377.description: [EN] Finding all the pieces to this complicated vehicle was one kind of a challenge. However, what you built in the end is rather a fabled than a feeble construction.
achievement.377.name: [EN] Fabled Construction
achievement.378.description: [EN] Barking dogs never bite, as the saying goes. But this one clearly tried. In the end, however, you were able to walk the dog - ahem, gnarlhound.
achievement.378.name: [EN] Mind the Dog!
achievement.379.description: [EN] This magnetic beast attracted you in a very literal way. Or was it attracted by your metal equipment? Anyway, you seem to be stuck together now.
achievement.379.name: Magnetised
achievement.38.description: Huwawinda, unazungumza nao. Unajua kwamba mizimu inaweza kuweka siri ambazo zimepotea kwa muda mrefu kati ya walio hai, na una ujuzi wa kuzungumza nao ili kukufunulia.
achievement.38.name: [EN] Ghostwhisperer
achievement.380.description: [EN] Counting ten thousand grains of sand could not have been harder than gaining this impressive mount.
achievement.380.name: [EN] Golden Sands
achievement.381.description: [EN] Kingly deer mostly prefer elves as friends and familiars. This one, however, decided to favour you as a confidant and rider. Well done!
achievement.381.name: [EN] Friend of Elves
achievement.382.description: [EN] Finding a four-leaved clover is always a sign of luck. And as luck would have it, you even baited a lovely dotted ladybug. Lucky you!
achievement.382.name: [EN] Lovely Dots
achievement.383.description: [EN] This fiery beast really tried to give you hell. But not even a magma crawler can resist a mug of spicy, hot glow wine. Skol!
achievement.383.name: [EN] Way to Hell
achievement.384.description: [EN] Not really twenty thousand miles, but you had to dive a fair way beneath the sea to find your personal Manta Ray.
achievement.384.name: [EN] Beneath the Sea
achievement.385.description: [EN] By many it is considered a myth like the Yeti. But you came, saw and tamed it. Now you're the proud rider of a midnight panther, black as a starless night.
achievement.385.name: [EN] Starless Night
achievement.386.description: [EN] By mastering the secrets of Lion's Rock, you proved yourself worthy to face the mighty lions there. One of them even chose to accompany you.
achievement.386.name: Lion King
achievement.387.description: [EN] Ah, the old carrot-on-a-stick trick. Well done! You've made the racing bird accept you as a rider and provider. Just don't feed it your fingers.
achievement.387.name: [EN] Pecking Order
achievement.388.description: [EN] Whoa, sow long! This boar is like a force of nature, breaking through the undergrowth of all the Tibian forests and all records of speed. Hang on!
achievement.388.name: Pig-Headed
achievement.389.description: [EN] It might come as a shock to you, but this is the mount of your dreams. Not exactly the white steed of Prince Charming, but maybe the ladies will still scream and faint at the sight of you.
achievement.389.name: [EN] Personal Nightmare
achievement.39.description: Una sehemu laini kwa wanyama wadogo, dhaifu, na unafanya kila uwezalo kuwalinda - hata kama labda unakula mazimwi kwa kiamsha kinywa.
achievement.39.name: Mwanaharakati wa Wanyama
achievement.390.description: [EN] It's unstoppable! Walls? Fortresses? Obstacles? Objections? Pah! Nothing will stand before the stampor. Arrows and spears bounce off its hide, enemies are trampled by the dozen. Just don't go for the subtle approach or a date on this thing.
achievement.390.name: [EN] Thick-Skinned
achievement.391.description: [EN] Don't let its fluffy appearance deceive you. The panda is a creature of the wild. It will take you to the most distant regions of Tibia, always in hopes of a little bamboo to nibble on or to check on a possible mate.
achievement.391.name: [EN] Chequered Teddy
achievement.392.description: [EN] Well, you can rest your nailcase now. This gravedigger's fingernails are nice and clean. Though after the next hellride, you might not want to let it hand any food to you.
achievement.392.name: [EN] Blacknailed
achievement.393.description: [EN] Drugging a snail can have some beneficial side effects. You're now the proud owner of a snarling, speed-crazy slug. Maybe it'll purr if you stroke it. Anyway, life should be one slick ride from now on.
achievement.393.name: [EN] Slugging Around
achievement.394.description: [EN] It's a wound-up wooden lizard! Well, stranger things have happened, or so you're told. Just hop on and let this wood-and-tin contraption take you anywhere you want to wind down a bit. And hope you don't get hit by lightning underway.
achievement.394.name: [EN] Knock on Wood
achievement.395.description: [EN] This must be underwater love - this enormous crustacean now does thy bidding. Or maybe it's just in it for a little more of that shrimp barbecue, as that's a little hard to come by in the sea.
achievement.395.name: [EN] Fried Shrimp
achievement.396.description: [EN] What a blast from the past! This thankful patient thinks you missed your dentist vocation. It's now ready to take a bite of the future and to carry you to your next adventure, or your next patient.
achievement.396.name: [EN] Out of the Stone Age
achievement.397.description: [EN] A drop of oil and you're good to go. This unique mount will roll merrily in and out of any strange place you want to visit. If you see no exit, you probably ended up in a circus ring. Ah well, the show must go on!
achievement.397.name: Stuntman
achievement.398.description: [EN] Installing that control unit was a no-brainer. Now you're in control to make it walk this way or that, or to change tack at any moment if required. Your faithful walker mount obeys your every command.
achievement.398.name: Gear Up
achievement.399.description: [EN] Hunter's greeting! Your skillful use of the slingshot actually stunned a large bear. The creature is slightly dazed, but seems susceptible to your commands. Let's declare open season on all our foes!
achievement.399.name: [EN] Bearbaiting
achievement.4.description: Umekuwa mwasi kila wakati - kubali! Kusambaza wafungwa, kutunza waliofukuzwa, kuiba kutoka kwa matajiri na kutoa kwa maskini - hakuna kusubiri, hiyo ilikuwa hadithi nyingine.
achievement.4.name: Vive la Upinzani
achievement.40.description: Umekumbatia dubu, kusukuma mamalia na kuthibitisha ujuzi wako wa kunywa. Na ingawa una hangover kidogo, mbavu iliyovunjika kwa kiasi na nywele zenye mafuta kwenye ulimi wako, unajivunia kujiita msomi wa heshima kuanzia sasa.
achievement.40.name: Msomi wa heshima
achievement.400.description: [EN] 'Sweets for my steed' could be your motto. An impressive horse is eating out of your hand. Saddle up and be ready to find adventure, new friends, and maybe someone to shoe your horse now and then.
achievement.400.name: [EN] Lucky Horseshoe
achievement.401.description: [EN] By cleverly using a leech to cool that raging bull's blood, you managed not to get swamped or trampled in a water buffalo stampede. The creature is now docile and follows your every command.
achievement.401.name: [EN] Swamp Beast
achievement.402.description: [EN] Seems like this spider has got a sweet tooth. As a result, eight hairy legs are now at your disposal to crawl and weave at your whim, and strike fear into the hearts of men.
achievement.402.name: Spin-Off
achievement.403.description: [EN] Here's looking at you, kid. This ancient creature seems to size you up with its brilliant eyes and barely tolerates you riding it. Maybe it thinks you're the defrosted snack, after all?
achievement.403.name: Icy Glare
achievement.404.description: [EN] You succeeded in finding and charting several previously unexplored landmarks and locations for the Adventurer's Guild, you probably never need to ask anyone for the way - do you?
achievement.404.name: [EN] Cartography 101
achievement.405.description: [EN] Lifting the secrets of a fabulous palace and defeating a beautiful demon princess was a thrilling experience indeed. This site's marvels nearly matched its terrors. Nearly.
achievement.405.name: [EN] Lost Palace Raider
achievement.406.description: [EN] It's dangerous to go alone... Take ten friends.
achievement.406.name: [EN] The More the Merrier
achievement.408.description: [EN] You went through hell. Seven times. You defeated the demons. Countless times. You put an end to Ferumbras claims to ascendancy. Once and for all.
achievement.408.name: [EN] Rift Warrior
achievement.41.description: Wewe ndiye unayeuliza maswali hapa, na unajua jinsi ya kupata majibu unayotaka kusikia. Mbali na hilo, wewe ni mtoaji pepo mashuhuri na unaua Vampires na mapepo wachache hapa na pale. Wewe na wadau wako ni timu kamili.
achievement.41.name: Mdadisi Mkuu
achievement.410.description: [EN] You sucessfully fought against all odds to protect your world from an ascending god! – You weren't there for the hat only after all?
achievement.410.name: Hat Hunter
achievement.411.description: [EN] You didn't manage to become an ogre chief. But at least you are, beyond doubt, a worthy ogre chef.
achievement.411.name: Ogre Chef
achievement.412.description: [EN] You opposed man-eating ogres and clumsy clomps. You grappled with hungry chieftains, desperate goblins and angry spirits. So you truly overcame the wild vastness of Krailos.
achievement.412.name: [EN] The Call of the Wild
achievement.413.description: [EN] You have entered the heart of destruction and valiantly defeated the world devourer. By your actions you have postponed the end of the world — at least for a while.
achievement.413.name: [EN] Ender of the End
achievement.414.description: [EN] After a long journey and dedication you were favoured by fortune and have tamed all three elusive beasts of the vortex. Unless the Vortexion decides you're a tasty morsel you can enjoy your small stable of ravaging beasts from beyond.
achievement.414.name: [EN] Vortex Tamer
achievement.415.description: [EN] Don't forget, even your rhino sometimes needs a hug. A careful one in this case.
achievement.415.name: [EN] Rhino Rider
achievement.416.description: [EN] You could not resist the taste of the forbidden fruit. Since you don't feel changed at all, it couldn't have been that bad after all. Or could it?
achievement.416.name: [EN] Forbidden Fruit
achievement.417.description: [EN] Perhaps with so much acquired knowledge, never meant for you, you know even when to stop! Time will tell whether this knowledge will do more harm or good.
achievement.417.name: [EN] Forbidden Knowledge
achievement.418.description: [EN] You wandered the world of Tibia in search of the ancient dragons' hoards. You are sure, you found them all.
achievement.418.name: [EN] Treasure Hunter
achievement.419.description: [EN] You met the legendary First Dragon and survived. That's a reason to celebrate for sure.
achievement.419.name: [EN] Reason to Celebrate
achievement.42.description: Weehee! Vunja minyoo hiyo! Hakika unajua jinsi ya kushughulikia nyundo kubwa.
achievement.42.name: [EN] Worm Whacker
achievement.420.description: [EN] You assisted a very prominent fae and you fought tooth and nail to earn this title.
achievement.420.name: [EN] Toothfairy Assistant
achievement.421.description: [EN] Teasing fairies is fun. They leave behind such pretty clouds of glittering dust when chased. Just hope they don't get you back for it.
achievement.421.name: [EN] Fairy Teasing
achievement.422.description: [EN] You have managed to stall the worst incursion of corruption. Still this is just one battle won in an all out war for your world.
achievement.422.name: [EN] Corruption Contained
achievement.43.description: Huna uhakika ni nini, lakini unahisi kuvutiwa na mrahaba. Magoti yako kila mara huchungiwa kidogo kutokana na kutambaa mbele ya viti vya enzi na unapenda kubarizi kwenye majumba. Labda unapaswa kuzingatia kuomba kama mlinzi?
achievement.43.name: Mfalme Tibianus shabiki
achievement.430.description: [EN] You have fully unlocked 10 easy monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.430.name: [EN] Little Adventure
achievement.431.description: [EN] You have fully unlocked 100 easy monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.431.name: [EN] Little Big Adventure
achievement.432.description: [EN] You have fully unlocked 10 medium monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.432.name: Contender
achievement.433.description: [EN] You have fully unlocked 100 medium monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.433.name: [EN] Serious Contender
achievement.434.description: [EN] You have fully unlocked 10 hard monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.434.name: [EN] Skilled Hunter
achievement.435.description: [EN] You have fully unlocked 100 hard monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.435.name: [EN] Master Hunter
achievement.436.description: [EN] You have fully unlocked your very first monster in the cyclopedia.
achievement.436.name: [EN] Hunting Permit
achievement.437.description: [EN] The Curse of the Full Moon transforms harmless citizens into feral beasts. But with your help, Edron and Cormaya are safe - fairly.
achievement.437.name: [EN] Over the Moon
achievement.438.description: [EN] You defeated the Count of the Core and destroyed his lava pump!
achievement.438.name: [EN] His Days are Counted
achievement.439.description: [EN] You defeated the Duke of the Depths and destroyed his lava pump!
achievement.439.name: [EN] Duked It Out
achievement.44.description: Wewe ni mwanariadha mwepesi na ni mzuri katika kuwasilisha bidhaa ambazo zinaweza kuoza kwa wakati, hata kama huwezi kutumia njia yoyote ya usafiri au mikono yako ikipata baridi au kunuka.
achievement.44.name: Kwa Wakati tu
achievement.440.description: [EN] You defeated the Baron from Below and destroyed his lava pump!
achievement.440.name: [EN] Buried the Baron
achievement.441.description: [EN] The Baron from Below, Duke of the Depths and the Count of the Core are no more!
achievement.441.name: [EN] Death in the Depths
achievement.442.description: [EN] You took the heat and defeated the Ancient Spawn of Morgathla!
achievement.442.name: [EN] Scourge of Scarabs
achievement.443.description: [EN] Exploring the depths of Tibia can be a dangerous task. Surprisingly, some crude wood planks, rusty nails and a tinged pot can offer a sufficient protection against the creatures lurking in the deep.
achievement.443.name: [EN] Cobbled and Patched
